name: Stage 22:1: Hälleforsnäs jvstn to Edströmsvallen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 22:1, Hälleforsnäs jvstn to Edströmsvallen.
utilities: Hälleforsnäs station is the official connector start with train/bus access, platform shelter context and listed parking; station-side food/toilet/water services should not be assumed.

Edströmsvallen is the official 22:1 connector end. Edströmsvallen and Bruket/Turistbyrån are practical parking/service starts for Bruksslingan, but event toilets/kiosk should not be treated as always-available trail services.

Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen nearby has shelter, grill/fireplace, fishing pier, picnic/rest places and accessible toilet, but those are continuation/loop facilities after the short station connector itself.

Start access is strongest at Hälleforsnäs station, with Mälartåg train service and bus 415 toward Flen. Check same-day Mälartåg/Sörmlandstrafiken departures and replacement-bus locations before committing.
waterSources: No confirmed public drinking-water tap was verified on stage 22:1 itself.

Use Hälleforsnäs/Bruket businesses, Coop, or the motorhome stop only when open/available; do not treat Bruksdammen, Bruksslingan wetlands, the motorhome stop, or its toilet as free public trail drinking-water sources.
If arriving from stage 22, the official Holmsjön south spring is the previous trail water source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 1.5 km from Hälleforsnäs railway station to Edströmsvallen/Bruksslingan. OSM relation 9636667 measures about 1.45 km and has the correct name/from/to/website but a wrong ref=21:1 tag, so show the official 22:1 label.

The route is split at the official connector end near OSM node 2540056176, 59.1564234,16.4869276. The longer Edströmsvallen-to-Bruksdammen walk is Bruksslingan/access continuation context, not part of the official 22:1 distance.

This is a signed access connector. After about 1.5 km it reaches Bruksslingan; roughly 500-600 m counter-clockwise on Bruksslingan reaches the first shared Stage 22/Bruksslingan node around 59.1591799,16.4779508, and the Bruksdammen information-board/junction cluster sits around 59.15805,16.4686.
Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Bruksslingan also showed no current faults, but its accessible toilet is closed in winter.

Winter reports describe the station-to-Edströmsvallen connector as sometimes icy, with snow hiding sparse markings in places. Treat winter accessibility and footing separately from Bruksslingan's reviewed winter maintenance and summer accessibility claims.

Surface is more village/cycleway/old-railway-bank connector than wilderness trail; local sources describe Gamla banvallen as walking/cycling access toward Edströmsvallen/Bruket, and hiker reports treat 22:1 more as transit access than a scenic standalone hike.

Do not mark Stage 22:1 itself as wheelchair-accessible unless field-verified. The verified accessibility claim belongs to Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen boardwalks, including the 1.3 m wide boardwalk to the island.
The Bruket/Edströmsvallen area is a mixed heritage, business and event area. Respect buildings, fences, yards, events and signed/private areas; do not camp, dig or disturb industrial-legacy ground.

Temporary access note checked 2026-04-28: Mälartåg listed April 27-May 1 disruption work, including April 27-30 train 2172 cancelled Hälleforsnäs-Västerås with replacement bus. Always verify live rail/bus status for this transit-first connector.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station
facilities.description: Official 22:1 start. Mälartåg train/bus access and platform shelter context; no verified public toilet, public water or station-side food service was found.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station rail-area safety
facilities.description: Live rail/bus area: use signed pedestrian routes, never shortcut across tracks, and expect replacement buses, taxis, parked cars and station movements around the access point.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs rail disruption note, Apr-May 2026
facilities.description: Dated access note from the 2026-04-28 pass: Mälartåg listed April 27-May 1 works, including April 27-30 train 2172 cancelled Hälleforsnäs-Västerås with replacement bus. Check live Mälartåg/Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on this.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station bus stop
facilities.description: Station bus stop with shelter/bench/bin/lit/tactile-paving context in OSM; bus 415 connects toward Flen. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station parking
facilities.description: Visit Flen lists Hälleforsnäs railway station parking for Stage 22:1, but exact bay geometry was not separately verified. Treat as station-area parking and check local signs.

facilities.name: Bruksskolan bus stop
facilities.description: Useful bus stop near the Bruket/Edströmsvallen service area. It is not at the Bruksdammen stage-junction end of the extended line; check live Sörmlandstrafiken.

facilities.name: Edströmsvallen connector end/access
facilities.description: Official 22:1 terminus/Edströmsvallen access point where the connector reaches the Bruksslingan area, matching OSM node 2540056176. Event kiosk/toilets are not guaranteed trail services.

facilities.name: Stage 22:1 no public water warning
facilities.description: No confirmed public drinking-water point was verified on the official 1.5 km connector. Do not treat Bruksdammen, Bruksslingan wetlands, toilets or the motorhome stop as potable trail water; ask at open businesses/services.

facilities.name: Bruksslingan / Turistbyrån start
facilities.description: Official Bruksslingan start; parking is recommended at Turistbyrån/Bruket or Edströmsvallen. Bruksslingan is the accessible loop, not the whole 22:1 connector.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen stage junction
facilities.description: Main stage junction beyond the 22:1 connector via Bruksslingan. Stage 22, 23 and 23:2 meet around this Bruksdammen context; it is not the official 22:1 endpoint.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen shelter nearby
facilities.description: Nearby Bruksslingan/stage-network shelter, not on the 1.5 km station connector itself. Useful if continuing to stage 22/23.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen fireplace / grill place nearby
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace at the Bruksdammen island shelter area on Bruksslingan, beyond the short station connector. Use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen accessible toilet nearby
facilities.description: Accessible dry toilet on the Bruksdammen island beyond the official connector; official Bruksslingan page says it is closed in winter and it should not be counted as a year-round Stage 22:1 toilet.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen picnic/rest places nearby
facilities.description: OSM maps several picnic tables/benches around the Bruksdammen shelter/toilet/firepit cluster. Useful rest context beyond the official 1.5 km connector.

facilities.name: Bruket / Hälleforsnäs tourist info
facilities.description: Tourist information and Bruket service cluster near the Bruksslingan start, with local tips, camper-pitch booking and canoe-rental context. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Coop Hälleforsnäs
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply near the connector/service area; check current opening hours.

facilities.name: Bruksrestaurangen
facilities.description: Restaurant in the Bruket cluster near the route/service area. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Fröken Larssons café
facilities.description: Cafe/lunch option at Celsings allé 13 near Coop and the connector service area; opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Femhundra Grader pizza
facilities.description: Pizza/food option in Bruket; opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Brukets stenugnsbageri
facilities.description: Bakery/fika option near Bruket and the connector service area. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Jürss Mejeri shop
facilities.description: Specialty cheese/local-food shop in the Bruket cluster near the Bruksslingan start; useful as opening-hour-dependent local resupply, not a general grocery.

facilities.name: Bruksmuseet / Bruket visitor context
facilities.description: Museum/visitor context in the Bruket cluster. Useful orientation stop; do not infer toilet or water unless the venue is open and confirms it.

facilities.name: Ställplats Bruket services
facilities.description: Motorhome stop/service area. Visit Flen confirms toilets/showers/electricity; some listings mention water, but do not assume free public trail-tap access without asking.

facilities.name: Edströmsvallen / Bruket heritage and industrial caveat
facilities.description: The Bruket/Edströmsvallen area mixes heritage buildings, active businesses, event venues, yards and industrial-legacy ground. Respect fences/private areas and avoid informal camping, digging or off-trail disturbance.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen fire and camping rule context
facilities.description: Use only prepared fireplaces and only when current fire rules allow; check Brandrisk Ute/Krisinformation. Do not camp informally in public, business or event areas around Bruket/Edströmsvallen.

facilities.name: Stage 22:1 winter ice/marking caveat
facilities.description: A winter trip report described the station-to-Edströmsvallen connector as icy in places, with some markings sparse or hidden by snow. Winter can reduce accessibility on connector paths and boardwalks; use poles/traction as needed.

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Hiker-oriented B&B near Sörmlandsleden in Hälleforsnäs with 6-7 beds, kitchen, WC/shower context; coordinate is approximate and availability must be checked.
